name: WolfHound
identity: Stocky low quadruped wolfhound with dark olive-brown coat, broad lighter khaki-brown jagged fur patches and warm ochre round spots. Large angular canine head, two upright triangular pointed ears with ochre inner pads visible FRONT ONLY, thick angular brows, large ivory eyes with tiny black pupils, broad dark brown nose with muted tan highlight, cream fangs and mouth. The original has a thick ochre-gold SPIKED COLLAR behind/around the base of the head, with short ivory triangular spikes. One collar only: keep it entirely with the HEAD piece, never repeat it on the torso. Four short sturdy brown legs with rounded dog paws. Short-to-medium thick upswept curved shaggy tail, pointed jagged tuft and lighter khaki inner fur; NOT a long thin or drooping tail. No white chest bib, gray winter coat, saddle, rider, helmet, horn or new equipment.

source_review.findings: Full own atlas and full serialized source viewed. Stocky khaki/olive-brown spotted wolfhound, pointed ears, ivory small-pupil eyes and fangs; original gold collar with ivory spikes belongs to head slice. Seven non-shadow renderers: head, torso, four short paws, upswept shaggy tail. No separate chest bib.
equipment: one ochre-gold collar with ivory spikes, assigned to head only
